title: 선생님이 오세요: 윗사람 이야기할 때 -(으)시-
objective: By the end, you can add -(으)시- to verbs in the present and past tense to show respect when a teacher, parent, or boss is the subject. You can also use 드시다, 계시다, and 주무시다 in place of 먹다, 있다, and 자다.
summary: Learn how to add -(으)시- to a verb to show respect for the person doing the action, including the special verbs 드시다, 계시다, and 주무시다.

task.title: Show respect with -(으)시-
task.line: Read each item, then write, choose, or check the verb form so that it shows respect for the right person.

forms.form: Verb stem ending in a vowel + -세요
forms.when: Use this when the action is done by someone you respect, like a parent, teacher, or boss, and the verb stem ends in a vowel.
forms.means: Shows respect for the person doing the action. The meaning of the verb does not change.
forms.exampleMeaning: My mother is going to the market now.

forms.form: Verb stem ending in a consonant + -으세요
forms.when: Use this when the stem ends in a consonant (except ㄹ). Add 으 before -세요.
forms.means: Shows respect for the person doing the action.
forms.exampleMeaning: My grandfather is reading the newspaper.

forms.when: Use this when the stem ends in ㄹ (살다, 알다, 만들다). Drop the ㄹ and add -세요. Do not add 으.
forms.means: Shows respect for the person doing the action.

forms.when: Use this when the respected person did the action in the past. Add -셨어요 after a vowel (or a dropped ㄹ) and -으셨어요 after a consonant.
forms.means: Shows respect and past tense together.
forms.exampleMeaning: The boss came to the shop yesterday.

forms.when: Use this when a respected person eats or drinks. Do not use 먹으세요.
forms.means: A special respectful word for 'eat' or 'drink'.

forms.when: Use this when a respected person is at a place.
forms.exampleMeaning: The teacher is in the classroom.

forms.when: Use this when a respected person sleeps.

watchOut: 제가 학교에 가세요 (X) → 제가 학교에 가요 (O): Never use -(으)시- when you are talking about yourself.
할아버지가 빵을 먹으세요 (X) → 할아버지가 빵을 드세요 (O): For 먹다, use the special word 드시다.
어머니가 집에 있으세요 (X) → 어머니가 집에 계세요 (O): When a respected person is at a place, use 계시다.
선생님이 서울에 살으세요 (X) → 선생님이 서울에 사세요 (O): With ㄹ stems, drop the ㄹ and do not add 으.
exercises: Fill in the blank with the honorific present form of the verb in brackets: ① 아버지가 회사에서 ____. (일하다) ② 선생님이 의자에 ____. (앉다) ③ 할머니가 떡을 ____. (만들다)
Choose the right word: ① 사장님이 지금 사무실에 (있으세요 / 계세요). ② 할아버지가 아침을 (먹으세요 / 드세요). ③ 아이가 방에서 (자요 / 주무세요).
Correct or wrong? If wrong, write the right verb: ① 제가 내일 학교에 오세요. ② 교수님이 책을 쓰세요. ③ 우리 할머니는 한국어를 잘 아세요. ④ 동생이 숙제를 하세요.
Change the sentence to the honorific past form: ① 선생님이 전화했어요. ② 할아버지가 우산을 찾았어요.
Answer the question in Korean using the information in brackets: ① 아버지는 지금 어디에 계세요? (home) ② 할머니는 무엇을 좋아하세요? (fruit)
answers: ① 일하세요 ② 앉으세요 ③ 만드세요
① 계세요 ② 드세요 ③ 자요
① Wrong → 와요 (제가 내일 학교에 와요.) ② Correct ③ Correct ④ Wrong → 해요 (동생이 숙제를 해요.)
① 선생님이 전화하셨어요. ② 할아버지가 우산을 찾으셨어요.
① 집에 계세요. (아버지는 지금 집에 계세요.) ② 과일을 좋아하세요. (할머니는 과일을 좋아하세요.)
